why: The build sent ticket 1057 back: pnpm typecheck failed with two TS2322 errors, in oxlint-plugins/anti-slop.ts's `written` and oxlint-plugins/anti-slop.test.ts's `levelOf`. A printed setting is `string | readonly [string, readonly unknown[]]`, and `Array.isArray` does not narrow a readonly tuple out of that union. Each branch now tests the string with Effect's `Predicate.isString`, a real type guard, so the other branch is the tuple; `levelOf` in anti-slop.ts had the same shape and got the same fix. No cast. No law changed: anti-slop.test.ts 19 of 19 and vendored.test.ts 5 of 5 pass, and one pnpm typecheck passes.
note: No new law, so no new plant: the change is the type of a helper the laws already cover, and their plants from the first round stand.
